note: Both sets extract similar claims with comparable accuracy on most values (e.g., Design Point CP/CT, Gen. Torque, Rotor Speed). Both sets suffer from internal contradictions on Rotor Thrust at 10 m/s (listing both ~2.25 MN and ~2.7/2.8 MN) and contain duplicate claims. Set A is slightly preferred because Set B contains more exact duplicates (e.g., TSR at 3 m/s listed twice with identical text, Blade Pitch at 7-10 m/s listed three times). Set B is marginally more accurate on Rotor Thrust at 25 m/s (1.0 MN vs 0.9 MN), but the higher redundancy in B outweighs this minor accuracy gain.
remarks: Both sets incorrectly include a claim for Generator Power = 0 MW at 3 m/s (visually the graph starts at 0, but physically cut-in is usually slightly higher; however, based strictly on the visual, 0 is defensible). The main differentiator is the number of exact duplicate claims, which is higher in Set B.
